ev.q: During the 12 months of active surveillance, 83 suspected dengue cases were investigated in Florida.
Recent dengue infection was laboratory-diagnosed in 18 (22%) of these cases.
Dengue cases were detected in Dade (eight), Hillsborough (four), Orange (three), Palm Beach (two), and Broward (one) counties.
